title: yummy smoky grilled peas
description: a smoky and savory croatian-inspired dish featuring frozen peas grilled to perfection in a donabe

ingredients.name: frozen peas
ingredients.notes: thawed in cold water before using

instructions: rinsse the thawed peas and pat dry with paper towels.
in a small bowl, mix together olive oil, smoked paprika, sea salt, and black pepper.
add the minced garlic to the bowl and mix well.
thread the peas onto the metal skewers, leaving a little space between each pea.
brush the skewers with the garlic and spice mixture.
place the skewers in the preheated grill and cook for 4-5 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
remove the skewers from the grill and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
serve the grilled peas hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
cook the donabe over the grill, if desired.
let the donabe heat up for 10-15 minutes before cooking the peas, if desired.
